# RenoBrief AI

> RenoBrief AI turns a room or exterior photo into a redesigned image, material list, budget range, and contractor-ready renovation brief.

Site: https://renobrief.com

## Core Pages
- [RenoBrief AI](https://renobrief.com/): Upload a room or exterior photo and get a redesigned image, material list, budget range, and contractor-ready renovation brief.

## Remodel Planning Tools
- [AI floor plan generator](https://renobrief.com/ai-floor-plan-generator/): Generate layout alternatives and contractor-ready floor plan notes from room photos or constraints.
- [AI exterior design](https://renobrief.com/exterior-design/): Explore exterior remodel ideas with facade, entry, color, material, and budget guidance.
- [AI interior design](https://renobrief.com/interior-design/): Create interior remodel concepts with style, material, budget, and contractor brief outputs.
- [Room design AI](https://renobrief.com/room-design-ai/): Turn one room into practical remodel ideas, furniture direction, palette guidance, and a brief.
